product_summary: Surat (Gujarat) based agri-commodity house, self-described as manufacturer, exporter and importer of grains, spices, oil seeds, pulses and feed. Catalogue on soyagreen.com: rice (Swarna non-basmati, Sona Masoori, RNR, IR64, Pusa/Sharbati/Sugandha basmati, parboiled), spices (dry red chilli, chilli seeds, turmeric, cardamom, cumin, coriander, dill), oil seeds (sesame, soyabean, sunflower, mustard), pulses (urad whole, chana, black eyed beans, chickpeas, toor, masoor, yellow peas, faba beans, green moong), feeds (maize, SBM, corn DDGS, rice DDGS, buckwheat, sorghum, green millets), other (raisins, onions, cashew). Import side since 2024: African toor/chickpeas, Australian faba bean and red lentil, Ukrainian/Russian yellow pea. Source: https://soyagreen.com (home page + About Us).
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — site claims own processing plant ('Process it in strict observation at our own plant') but the catalogue is a broad multi-origin trading/aggregation book (37+ destination countries, import of pulses from Africa/Australia/Ukraine/Canada). No plant, capacity or certification evidence was retrievable (product sub-pages return 404), so the manufacturing claim is заявлено, не подтверждено.
comment: HS comparison: only 071340 (masoor/red lentil) is an exact hit — and even that is described on the site mainly as an IMPORT line (Australian red lentil), not an export line. 100630 (basmati/semi-milled rice) is a partial hit: the site does list basmati and parboiled rice, but the declared code covers only basmati-type semi-milled/milled rice while the bulk of the rice book (Swarna, Sona Masoori, RNR, IR64, parboiled) is non-basmati and would sit under 100630 only if milled — the declaration does not distinguish, so partial. 091099 (other spices, nes) is a partial/loose fit: the real spice lines are chilli (090421/090422), turmeric (091030), cardamom (090831), cumin (090931), coriander (090921), dill (090940) — 091099 is a residual code that would only catch the ground/other residue, so the declared spice code is effectively wrong for the main spice lines. 080299 ('other nuts, fresh or dried') is WRONG: the only nut-type item on the site is cashew (080131/080132), and 080299 does not cover cashew; there is no other nut in the catalogue at all. Major product lines entirely MISSING from the declaration: oil seeds (120740 sesame, 120190 soyabean, 120600 sunflower, 120750 mustard) — despite 'Soya' being in the company name and being the founding 2013 business; the whole pulses import/export book (071331, 071320, 071335, 071360, 071310, 071350, 071390); feeds (100590 maize, 230400 SBM, 230330 DDGS, 100810, 100790, 100829); raisins (080620), onions (070310). Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is a misclassification: this is a bulk agricultural-commodity exporter/importer (agri raw materials, feed grains), not FMCG/consumer packaged food. Trader signs: multi-origin sourcing, import book launched 2024, 37+ countries, no verifiable plant documentation — consistent with manufacturer_trader at best, pure trader plausible. Per project rules the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, declared codes corrected to the list above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product data here is website-declared only — no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this task, therefore every line above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Revenue, export volume, CIN/PAN and shipment facts: null (not researched in this role).
